name_zh: 玻利瓦尔/哥伦比亚/解放/大哥伦比亚/独裁/宪法/西蒙/玻利瓦尔
description_zh: 西蒙·玻利瓦尔 (1783-1830) 委内瑞拉/哥伦比亚/玻利维亚解放军领袖，领导反西班牙独立战争，建立大哥伦比亚共和国，推翻殖民统治，实现拉美独立，实行宪法独裁，推动泛美一体化，被誉为'解放者'，玻利瓦尔梦奠定拉美地缘政治基础。
description_en: Simon Bolivar (1783-1830) Venezuelan/Colombian/Bolivian military leader, led anti-Spanish independence wars, established Greater Colombia Republic, overthrew colonial rule, achieved Latin American independence, implemented constitutional dictatorship, promoted pan-American integration, known as 'Liberator', Bolivar Dream laid foundation for Latin American geopolitical structure.
reason_zh: 玻利瓦尔代表拉美独立战争如何重塑地缘政治格局，展示了反殖民斗争如何建立新的国家体系，其大哥伦比亚试验体现了泛美一体化理想，其宪法独裁模式影响拉美后世国家建设，其解放者神话塑造了拉美共同身份。
reason_en: Bolivar represents how Latin American independence wars reshape geopolitical landscape, demonstrates how anti-colonial struggle establishes new nation systems, his Greater Colombia experiment embodies pan-American integration ideal, his constitutional dictatorship model influences post-colonial Latin American state-building, his Liberator myth constructs shared Latin American identity.
steps_zh: 研究玻利瓦尔早年加拉加斯/殖民环境/反殖民意识形成
分析1810-1819年独立战争/军事战略/组织结构
探讨1819-1822年大哥伦比亚建立/宪法制定/中央集权
评估1828-1830年独裁统治/内战/联邦主义危机
总结独立遗产/领土版图/拉美地缘政治/玻利瓦尔神话
steps_en: Study Bolivar early Caracas/colonial environment/anti-colonial consciousness formation
Summarize independence legacy/territorial maps/Latin American geopolitics/Bolivar myth
expected_zh: 理解拉美独立战争如何重塑地缘政治格局，掌握反殖民斗争如何建立新的国家体系，评估大哥伦比亚实验对泛美一体化的影响，认识玻利瓦尔神话在拉美身份建构中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how Latin American independence wars reshape geopolitical landscape, grasp how anti-colonial struggles establish new nation systems, evaluate Greater Colombia experiment impact on pan-American integration, recognize Bolivar myth role in Latin American identity construction.
